submitted_query: I am looking for an office building. The location is in Turin. I need a property with at least 360 sqm of gross floor area and capacity for 18 people. I prefer properties near healthcare services.

scenario_definition.oracle_query: Find an office building to convert it into an autonomous senior day center (CDIA) for 18 guests in Turin with at least 360 sqm of gross floor area in energy class D or better near healthcare services.

D: It depends; something suitable for the project, I guess.

clarifications.Ce: I prefer a property in energy class D or better.

requirements.description: Prefers proximity to healthcare services; threshold rounded to the 75th percentile (89.9).
The request is for an office building.
The requested minimum gross floor area is 360 sqm.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE property_type = 'Offices and similar' AND surface_area >= 360 AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 AND healthcare >= 90 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC
